messages:
alice: FYI I opened a docs PR for the Python SDK migration guide — ready for review when anyone has a min. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1234 :seedling:
ben: looking now. quick q — do we keep the old 'client' examples or fully switch to the new 'Redwood' class?
carla: prefer new API but keep a short snippet showing old->new mapping for folks migrating. one-liner at the top should be enough.
dan: CI preview is failing on the code block linting, says 'fenced-code-language-missing' for the Bash snippet. I'll fix in a follow-up commit unless you want it in this PR.
alice: thanks. yeah add the mapping snippet + fix the fence. also pinging @ben for tone/terminology check — we need to enforce "instance" vs "client" naming everywhere per style guide.
ben: got it. I skimmed the prose; a few tone things: avoid marketing adjectives in API surface examples (e.g., remove "super-fast") and keep imperative voice in how-to steps.
carla: small nit — headings should use sentence case per docs style. I noticed "QuickStart" in the guide, should be "Quick start".
alice: noted, will update headings. dan, can you paste the exact CI error message so I can replicate locally?
dan: sure: ```
Error: fenced-code-language-missing at docs/migrations/python-sdk.md:45
  43 | ```
  44 | $ pip install redwood
> 45 | ```
Fix: add the language like ```bash
```
carla: also we call out the environment variable REDWOOD_API_KEY in other pages. here we used API_KEY_REDWOOD — change to canonical REDWOOD_API_KEY. that was the main terminology mismatch.
alice: good catch. I'll grep and normalize in this PR.
ben: on reviewers — I'm happy to do a content pass for terminology and tone, carla can do formatting/structure. can we request a merge window in the morning? there's a docs deploy at 10:00 UTC. want to land before that to get a preview live.
dan: note from infra: docs preview builds queue up during the deploy window; if we land <10m before deploy it might not show up. aim for 30m buffer.
alice: ok let's target 09:30 UTC. I'll aim for final commit by 09:15 and request review from ben/carla.
carla: if you need me earlier i can do a quick pass at 08:45 UTC.
ben: I'll do content review at 09:00 UTC.
docs-bot: Preview build queued — build #842 will run on merge to main. Status: queued.
alice: updated PR with fixes: - added old->new mapping snippet, - fixed fenced code languages, - normalized REDWOOD_API_KEY, - heading case changes. PTAL. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1234
ben: LGTM on content, left two tiny reword suggestions (imperative voice).
carla: formatting clean. one remaining suggestion: convert a long paragraph into a short numbered step list for the migration checklist. makes scans easier.
alice: done. converted to numbered list and pushed.
dan: CI green now, preview URL: https://deploy-preview.redwood-inference.com/1234 — looks good.
ben: preview looks fine. no marketing words left, examples runnable.
carla: thumbs up.
alice: thanks all — merging at 09:30 UTC per plan. marking this thread resolved. :white_check_mark:
